name: Balaji Amines Ltd
title: Balaji Amines Ltd-$ - 530999 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin 25% on 12% revenue growth, but supply-side is expanding into weak utilisation (DME, DMF, butylamines, battery chemicals at 20-25%) while management guides 25-30% volume growth by FY27 end.

utilisation.quote: we roughly at a company level operate at 35%, 40% utilization

capex.quote: Its total INR750 crores in first phase, we'll be spending about INR350 crores to INR400 crores.

triggers.label: Company utilisation ~35-40% (analyst est.)
triggers.quote: we roughly at a company level operate at 35%, 40% utilization

triggers.label: Specialty capex INR750cr phased, FY26-27 spend INR275-290cr
Raw material prices 2.5-3x normal
triggers.quote: sometimes it is double even 3 times also 2.5 times of it's regular prices

triggers.label: EDA/DETA prices fell from ~300 to 270-280
triggers.quote: Average Q4 numbers are about 300. And today, it is about 270 to 280.

triggers.label: FY27 volume growth 10-15% (cut from 25-30%)
triggers.quote: I assume it will be 10% to 15% volume growth should be there

guidance.value: 25% to 30% by end FY27; later 10-15% for FY27
guidance.quote: I assume it will be 10% to 15% volume growth should be there
the EBITDA should be sustainable between 22% to 23%, on the total sales
We will be definitely reaching INR3,000 crores in 2028.
